Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) completes a 2-kilometre widening on Sheikh Zayed Road by adding a new lane for traffic coming from Abu Dhabi, near Burj Khalifa-Dubai Mall Metro Station and heading towards World Trade Centre Intersection. The widening increases the number of lanes from six to seven, raising road capacity by 17% and reducing journey time by up to 10% during peak hours.

Parkin Company and Q Mobility, the leading operator of public parking in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, sign a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen collaboration on smart parking solutions and enhance digital integration between the parking ecosystems of the two emirates. The MoU will support sustainable urban mobility and reinforce the UAE’s position at the forefront of smart mobility adoption.
